lead.tldr: SEC settles Justin Sun fraud case for $10M drawing Warren criticism amid regulatory flux. • Solana payment volume surges 755% signaling real adoption despite SOL price weakness. • IRS electronic tax forms proposed leaving staking double taxation unresolved for investors. • Kazakhstan central bank eyes $350M crypto investments starting April boosting legitimacy. • Bitcoin and Solana ETFs post outflows as BTC dips below $71K pressuring short-term holdings. • Morgan Stanley files for spot Bitcoin ETF while ICE backs OKX at $25B valuation.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, SEC settles fraud case with Justin Sun for $10M amid regulatory shifts like IRS crypto tax proposals. Solana's 755% payment surge and Kazakhstan's $350M crypto investments signal growing adoption and institutional interest.

top_signals.title: SEC ends fraud case against Justin Sun after $10M settlement
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has settled its 2023 civil fraud case against Justin Sun, founder of Tron, and his companies including Tron Foundation and BitTorrent Foundation, with Rainberry Inc. paying a $10 million penalty. The allegations involved unregistered sales of TRX and BTT crypto assets, wash trading to inflate volumes by $31 million, and undisclosed payments to celebrities like Lindsay Lohan for promotions. Sun and his firms neither admitted nor denied wrongdoing, and all charges were dismissed pending court approval. For institutional investors, this resolution under the Trump administration signals a regulatory shift toward crypto innovation, potentially reducing enforcement risks and boosting TRX ecosystem participation.

top_signals.title: Can Solana’s 755% payment surge trigger a SOL supercycle?
top_signals.summary: Solana's payment volume has surged by 755%, potentially indicating increased adoption and a possible 'supercycle' for the SOL token. The rise in payment volumes positions Solana as a key player in driving Web3 adoption.

top_signals.title: IRS proposes electronic crypto tax forms, but what about the staking tax issue?
top_signals.summary: The IRS is proposing electronic crypto tax forms, but the issue of double taxation on mining and staking rewards remains unclear. This suggests ongoing regulatory challenges in the crypto space.

top_signals.title: Vitalik Buterin calls for bolder experimentation in Ethereum's app layer while preserving core principles
top_signals.summary: Vitalik Buterin is encouraging Ethereum developers to be more experimental with applications built on the network, while maintaining the fundamental principles of Ethereum.

top_signals.title: Kazakhstan central bank to invest up to $350 million in crypto-related assets: report
top_signals.summary: The central bank of Kazakhstan plans to invest up to $350 million in crypto-related assets, including crypto-linked companies and index funds. The investments are expected to commence in April or May.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin and Solana ETFs See Outflows Amid Market Dip
top_signals.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced outflows of $228 million as the price of BTC dropped below $71,000. Solana ETFs also saw outflows, marking their first losses since February.

top_signals.title: NYSE parent ICE invests in crypto exchange OKX at $25 billion valuation amid tokenized stocks push: Fortune
top_signals.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE parent) has invested in crypto exchange OKX, valuing the company at $25 billion. This investment comes as tokenization is gaining momentum.

top_signals.title: Wall Street’s crypto embrace: Morgan Stanley files for Spot Bitcoin ETF
top_signals.summary: Morgan Stanley has filed for a Spot Bitcoin ETF, signaling increasing institutional interest in cryptocurrency investments. This move indicates a growing acceptance of Bitcoin among major financial institutions.

top_signals.title: FBI Arrests Man Who Allegedly Stole $46M From U.S. Marshals
top_signals.summary: John Daghita was arrested for allegedly stealing over $46M in crypto from the U.S. Marshals Service. He reportedly used his father's access to commit the theft.

top_signals.title: Suspect in alleged $46 million US Marshals crypto theft arrested in Saint Martin, FBI says
top_signals.summary: A suspect has been arrested in Saint Martin in connection to the alleged theft of $46 million in cryptocurrency from the US Marshals. The suspect was previously linked by ZachXBT to the online persona "Lick," who allegedly accessed wallets holding crypto seized in the 2016 Bitfinex hack.

top_signals.title: Core Scientific secures up to $1B credit from Morgan Stanley for data centers
top_signals.summary: Core Scientific has secured up to $1 billion in credit from Morgan Stanley to support its data center operations. This substantial credit line indicates strong financial backing for Core Scientific's infrastructure development.
